scope: First game process reference. Parameters are sizing assumptions; no full temperature, pressure, purity or heat rejection certification.

process.note: Crusher and compactor operate as separate pipeline stages. Initial fill, source availability, power, valves and full destinations change elapsed time.

thermalReference.limits: Rest material heating, separation, pumps and losses share an assumed aggregate margin. Unknown material is treated as insoluble residue. No dissolved contaminant chemistry or sterilisation validation.
